name: BORROWER_360_MODEL
description: Unified borrower 360 for an Indian mixed-NBFC retail lending portfolio.
  Combines RBI-compliant credit risk classification (borrower-level, per IRAC norms),
  balance-transfer flight risk (structurally separated from credit risk - a distressed
  borrower always scores zero BT risk), a lifetime-value proxy (expected future interest
  income from the real amortization schedule, assuming the loan runs to full term),
  and sentiment/behavioral trajectory signals derived from sequenced call transcripts.
  Paired with the deterministic next-best-action recommendation engine, where every
  action traces to a named rule and carries an expected value.
